flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then For every product card on the page, read its name and its stock or scarcity message (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock").
Get every product card's name and stock or scarcity message as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" and save as {{stock_1}}.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ again so the page fully loads fresh, read every product card again the same way, and store the list as stock_2.
Get every product card's name and stock or scarcity message from the page after its own fresh load as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" and save as {{stock_2}}.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ once more and store the list as stock_3.
Get every product card's name and stock or scarcity message from the page after its own fresh load as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" and save as {{stock_3}}.
Read each list from the page after its own fresh load; do not copy an earlier value.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there are no stock messages, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
